channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: AI in medicine: Union minister highlights role in minimising human error at Medllumina 2026
item.description: Dr. Singh explained that traditional diagnosis relies heavily on a doctor's personal judgement and experience, which can lead to oversights—for example, a pathologist may miss tiny clusters of affected cells in a biopsy. AI-enabled systems, by contrast, can scan and identify critical areas, improving accuracy.

item.title: Unseasonal Heat Wave: Srinagar Logs Warmest February Day in History
item.description: Srinagar on Saturday recorded its highest-ever maximum temperature for February, touching 21.0°C and surpassing the previous 2016 record. The reading stood a striking 10°C above normal, marking an extraordinary late-winter anomaly in the Kashmir Valley.

item.title: Yash to have double role in Toxic? Clean-shaven transformation revealed after gritty bearded look
item.description: Yash's bearded look, as Raya had earlier gone viral, inspiring fan art, reels, and online theories. Now, his clean-shaven transformation arrives like a curveball, once again setting social media ablaze.

item.title: Swami Avimukteshwaranand rejects child sexual abuse allegation, calls complaint false
item.description: Swami Avimukteshwaranand has denied allegations of child sexual abuse, calling the complaint "false" and expressing confidence that the judicial process will reveal the truth. Speaking to the media, he said that once the investigation under the FIR proceeds, the facts would become clear.

item.title: Business leadership built on people and values; focus on energy, logistics, infra, more opportunities for tier-3 & tier-4 students: Karan Adani
item.description: Earlier, he reiterated that the Adani Group remains focused on three core sectors, energy utilities, logistics including ports and airports, and infrastructure, while creating greater opportunities for students from tier-3 and tier-4 cities.

item.title: DIIs continue to provide strong support to markets driven by strong domestic cues
item.description: FIIs recorded net outflows of approximately Rs 7,000 crore in the cash market for the week ending February 20, amid volatile trading sessions marked by heavy selling on February 13 (Rs 7,395 crore outflow).

item.title: Trump, Modi vision drives new US–India AI alliance; reject 'paralysis of fear'
item.description: Under the US-India AI Opportunity Partnership, an addendum to the Pax Silica Declaration, the two countries pledged regulatory alignment, stronger semiconductor and critical mineral supply chains, and deeper private-sector collaboration. The pact also aims to build a "Physical AI Stack".

item.title: Trump lifts global tariff to 15%, cites Section 122 of Trade Act of 1974
item.description: In a post on Truth Social, Trump criticised the Supreme Court's decision and said the 15 per cent rate, the maximum allowed under the statute, would take effect immediately. He signalled that his administration would soon determine and issue new, legally permissible tariffs.

item.title: How a Rural Kerala Startup is Reimagining Professional Networking for Gen Z: The Connester Story
item.description: Connester is an all-in-one professional networking and opportunity discovery platform for India's Gen Z, bridging the gap between rural talent and global careers.

item.title: My children's never watched any of my films so far: Shalini Ajith Kumar
item.description: Shalini Ajith Kumar has revealed that her children have not watched any of her movies so far. Everytime she plans it, they postpone it saying that they will watch it later.
